title: TomTom2
description: Road closures aren't a problem anymore: calimoto makes it unique. Our riders have been asking for this for years and now it's finally here, exclusively in calimoto and unmatched in the motorcycle navigation market. In close collaboration with TomTom, calimoto now detects closed and restricted roads directly on the map and automatically reroutes around them. Riders can see detailed POIs, plan tours without interruptions, and stay flexible even when closures appear mid-ride. This feature delivers real value: more control, safety, and freedom for motorcyclists. It's a first in our category, solving a major pain point and showcasing strong technical innovation. Its uniqueness, user demand, and impact on the riding experience make it a standout candidate for an Apple Store feature nomination. Calimoto is built by a passionate team in Potsdam, Germany, dedicated to making motorcycling safer and more fun. We combine cutting-edge tech with user-driven design to deliver unique features like twisty-road routing and now real-time road closure avoidance. Our rider-focused approach and close community feedback set us apart, ensuring real value and joy to the ride.
